description.value: Bella Soriah is a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant in downtown Nakusp, BC, owned and operated by industry veterans Tyler Leeson and Leslie Williamson, who bring experience from Vancouver, Montreal, and Australia. The kitchen serves Mediterranean dishes infused with local British Columbia ingredients in a setting designed to be cozy and comfortable without sacrificing exceptional food and service. The restaurant also makes its space available for private group events and buyouts.
